the O.P. No.2 :M/s. Arun Kumar, Advocate
---
05/23.03.2023

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gumla (Mahila) P. S. Case No. 14/2022,
registered under Sections 323/ 341/ 342/ 498A/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 03/ 04 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Gumla.
At the very outset it was submitted that the parties have resolved their dispute.
The offence alleged is under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Gumla in connection with Gumla (Mahila) P. S. Case No. 14/2022, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
